title: Swimmer Coleman joins Alido as flag-bearer for Youth Olympic Games
summary: Another swimmer in Riannah Chantelle Coleman will join Jamesray Mishael Ajido as a flag-bearer in the opening ceremony of the Fourth Youth Olympic Games (YOG) on October 31 in Dakar.
